notes: Virtual-device validation only. Physical RF, antenna, electrical properties, range, power, and real tag behavior were NOT RUN.

Original Core2 binary and whole-device execution were NOT RUN: Unit-model admission was unavailable. CoreS3 PORT.A UART1 RX1/TX2 exercised the identical public JRD4035 and UHFRFIDUnit source path under UIFlow2 CoreS3 v2.5.5 preview.
Timed same-query fragmentation was NOT RUN / BLOCKED_FIXTURE. Queue separators select the next command response; they do not represent delayed chunks.

The response-byte mirror represents configured data, not an independent wire capture. Application results, actual controller command/injection counters, VFS source readback and serial markers are separate observations.
The actual Unit-state contract exposes no read-byte counter; no expected read count was substituted for an observation.

Only inventory and its immediate recovery/queued FIFO behavior were tested. The 35 shared command callers, continuous inventory, other response decoders, arbitrary timing and long-duration reliability are not certified.
The maintained parser keeps a fixed 512-byte payload cap and absolute ticks deadline. Compatibility of other command lengths is a review boundary.

The source overlay was composed into the VFS of the admitted official base image. Native/non-VFS bytes and source readback were checked. Stock frozen-source behavior and an official firmware rebuild were NOT RUN.
